output.methodChoice: EDF two-item collection: X15 (interim estimation and incident-app memo) then stopped.
output.brief: The rise in store 14's shrink is probably not a real, proven loss increase. The store's shrink is estimated from partial cycle counts, and the company's own back-tests show interim readings can swing by this much without the year-end count confirming them. Chain-wide, recorded shoplifting incidents jumped when a new incident app launched on 1 April while chain shrink stayed flat, so the logging change may explain the incident rise. Store 14's full-count shrink was 1.5% in FY2025, in line with normal. The staff-theft tip was checked on CCTV and showed only cardboard bales. Self-checkout and staff theft are not ruled out, but nothing so far points to them. My confidence is moderate. Next: keep store 14 in the 7 December full physical count, reject the proposal to drop it, and hold off on a guard, suspending anyone, or new loss-prevention spending until the full count is compared with the interim figures.
